i.norm: Verifies that the NYSIIS encoder (in default strict mode, max 6 chars) correctly encodes a mixed-case alphanumeric string containing special characters and digits. Input "dIpYze0FuZfr/K1EPh%" — after cleaning (non-alpha stripped, uppercased) becomes "DIPYZEFUZFRKEEPH", which the NYSIIS algorithm encodes to "DAPYSA".
strict mode: output capped at 6 characters
